address: corso Umberto I 125, Cava de' Tirreni, 84013, Italy
bio: A modern restaurant with an elegant, contemporary decor situated on the main pedestrian street in the town centre. The menu features an excellent selection of raw dishes, as well as a good choice of oysters and caviar, plus an equally delicious house speciality: fried pizza marinara with San Marzano tomato cream, garlic mayonnaise, black olive ash and Cetara anchovies. Sparkling wines are to the fore on the wine list....
